Voice input is off in password and private fields.

Swipe the space bar to change language
The app has no internet permission: no server, no account, no analytics. Typed text and audio are not stored or logged. The dictionary, translation glossary, settings and models stay on this device.
Restore all keyboard settings to their defaults?
Change language: the language key (mobile keyboard), swiping the space bar, or Win+Space on the computer keyboard. The current language is written on the space bar.

Shortcuts work only in the keyboard\'s computer mode (the keyboard button on the top bar), which has Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Win keys. Tap a modifier, then the key: for example Win, then Space switches the language. Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V and other shortcuts of the app itself (Excel, Vim…) work where that app supports them. A combination of modifiers only (for example Alt+Shift) runs when no other key follows within half a second.
Choose Ctrl, Alt or Win with a key, or at least two modifiers without a key.
This replaces a standard command (copy, paste, undo …).
Runs half a second after the last modifier if no key follows.
Off by default. Single words are stored on this phone only, with a use count — never whole messages. Nothing is learned in password, private (incognito), e-mail and address fields.
Suggestions come from about 30,000 common words per language plus your own words (shown first). Tap inserts a word; long press removes one of your words.
Only letters, apostrophe and hyphen; 2–40 characters.
…and %1$d more. Use search to find them.
Delete the whole dictionary in all languages?
Models are files that let the keyboard recognise speech and translate right on the phone, without internet. Normal typing works fully without them. Download only what you need — once.
Importing %1$s… this can take a minute.
Needed for the Voice button. Without the model of a language you cannot dictate in it.

Needed for the translate button. Each direction is a separate file; without it that direction does not work. The accurate models translate noticeably better but are three times bigger and slower — good for phones with 6 GB of memory or more.
Allow the microphone in the app settings to use voice input.
Say “кома”, “крапка”, “знак питання”, “новий рядок” (Polish: “przecinek”, “kropka”, “znak zapytania”, “nowa linia”; English: “comma”, “period”, “question mark”, “new line”).

Above the keys: Aa Text · translate (tap again to pick the other language) · translate the selection or clipboard · Voice. You translate from the keyboard language: switch the keyboard to Polish to translate from Polish. While you type, the field shows your text and the strip above the keys shows the translation; it replaces your text once — automatically after . ! ?, Enter or a pause, in manual mode only after Enter. Tapping ✓ restores the original. Everyday phrases (\"How are you?\") use a built-in phrasebook.
Text changed — restore it by hand
Translate the selected text, or paste the clipboard translated
Insert the translation after a pause in typing
More accurate translation (beam search, a little slower)
1. Turn the keyboard on in Android
Android warns that any keyboard can see what you type — this is its standard message. This keyboard has no internet access, so nothing leaves the phone.
All set. Tap any text field to type.
No browser found to open the link.

How: 1) «Download» next to a model — the browser saves the file. 2) When it is done, tap «Open» in the browser and choose OffKey: the model installs by itself. Or tap «Install downloaded files» below and pick one or several files — the keyboard recognises each one.
You can add your own model file: a small Vosk model (a zip with am, conf and graph folders) for a voice language, or an OffKey translation pack. Use the Import button of the matching row.

Cheat sheets for popular apps: \"Show tips\" opens a list of the app\'s own shortcuts, for reference only. The \"Add\" button also puts ready-made shortcuts that type text (Excel formulas, Vim commands) into your list; they work in computer mode.
Type on the computer over Bluetooth
«%1$s» cannot be typed in this computer layout
Computer not connected — tap for Bluetooth settings
The phone becomes a Bluetooth keyboard for your computer, like a real one: no app or internet needed on the computer.
Use the phone as a computer keyboard
Bluetooth is off on the phone
This phone does not allow keyboard mode (some manufacturers block it).
First time: tap «Make the phone visible», then on the computer open Settings → Bluetooth → Add device and choose this phone. Next time it reconnects by itself, or tap «Connect».
Open the keyboard in any field (for example below) and tap the Bluetooth button above the keys: it turns coloured and everything you type goes to the computer. Tap it again to type on the phone.
Tap here to open the keyboard

The keyboard sends keys, like a real one: the computer must use the same language as the phone (Укр/Pol/Eng). Win+Space switches both. The computer keyboard mode gives you Ctrl, Alt, Win, F1–F12 and arrows. Characters the computer layout has no key for are not sent. While keys are sent to the computer, suggestions, translation and voice are paused: every key goes straight to the computer. Typing on the phone itself (also in the computer layout) has them all.
From the keyboard language into this one. The translate button above the keys switches between the two other languages.

If the translation gets a word or phrase wrong, write the right version here. The keyboard puts it into the translation itself; a line that is a whole sentence is used as the translation of that sentence.

One line per word: українська | polski | English. Several forms with «/»: the first is used in translations. «*» at the end matches any ending, e.g. палет* = палета, палети, палетах. Lines starting with # are notes.
Installing… large models take a minute.

Stickers cannot be sent to a computer
Emoji or text smileys separated by spaces, e.g. 🦄 🐙 ¯\\_(ツ)_/¯. They get their own ★ page in the emoji panel.
The 🕘 page shows the emoji you use most; it fills up by itself.
Add GIF, WebP, PNG or JPEG pictures from the phone (up to 8 MB). In the sticker panel, a long press adds a sticker to favourites ★; favourites and the most used come first.
Show the pressed letter above the finger
Compact toolbar: one row, modes under the ▦ button
Fix typos (Backspace right after brings your word back)
Drag Backspace to the left to delete words
Kept «%1$s»; it will not be corrected again
Frames and glow; letters stay clear
Row height; the keyboard does not jump while typing
Smart punctuation: no space before a comma, one after it

OffKey is an offline keyboard for Ukrainian, Polish and English. Typing with suggestions and typo correction, your own dictionary, voice input, translation between the three languages, emoji and stickers, a number pad, a computer layout with Ctrl, Alt and F keys, and a Bluetooth keyboard mode for a computer. Everything runs on the phone — no internet, no accounts, no ads.

Import adds words from a file:
• .txt — one word per line; the words go to the language selected above (%1$s);
• JSON — a list per language: {"uk": ["слово"], "pl": ["słowo"], "en": ["word"]}.
Words shorter than 4 letters are skipped. Export saves all your words as JSON, most used first.

One file with all settings (own emoji and shortcuts included), your dictionary and the translation glossary. Restoring replaces what is on this phone now. Voice and translation models are not included: add them again on the models page.
This file is not an OffKey backup.
Arrows, Home and End above the letters of the mobile keyboard, to move the cursor precisely. The keyboard keeps its height: the keys get a little lower.
On the mobile keyboard only the text strip shows; tap it to show the modes, keyboard switch and settings buttons. They hide again a few seconds later.

• «Turn on» on the main page — tick OffKey in the list of keyboards.
• «Choose» — pick OffKey; the steps disappear.
• The «Try it» field — try everything from this help there.
• Everything works offline; voice and translation need models (section «Voice and translation»).
• «Look» — the Black Glass or Black Sketch style, key brightness and height.

• Hold a letter — its options: Ukrainian ґ ї, Polish letters, the corner digit. Slide to one and let go.
• Hold the comma — emoji.
• Swipe the space bar — another language; the current one is written on it.
• Hold ⌫ — deletes character by character; drag ⌫ left — whole words.
• Tap the strip above the keys — the buttons appear: modes on the left, computer keyboard and settings on the right.
• The modes button — Text, Translate, Clipboard, Voice.

• A word ends with a space or a mark — one slip onto a neighbouring key is fixed («helli» → «hello»).
• ⌫ right after a fix — brings your word back and remembers it.
• Rare but correct words are left alone.
• Suggestions above the keys — tap inserts a word; hold — remove your word.
• Turn off — «Typing» → «Fix typos»; suggestions — «My dictionary».

• Start of a sentence — a capital by itself, also right after «?» and «!».
• A space before , . ! ? : ; — moves after the mark.
• After , ; ! ? : — a space appears by itself when you start the next word (not in numbers or addresses).
• Two quick spaces — «. ».
• ⌫ right after such a change — puts it back as typed.
• Turn each off — «Typing».

• A number or phone field — the number pad at once.
• + − × / — plain signs that calculators understand.
• Hold the point — a comma.
• «ABC» bottom left — back to the letters.
• «?123» — symbols; «=\<» — more symbols; «123» on the symbols — the number pad by hand.

• The keyboard button at the top — computer or mobile keyboard; the same height.
• Esc, Tab, Caps, Ctrl, Alt, Win, Fn (F1–F12), Del and arrows — as on a PC.
• Tap Ctrl/Alt/Win — for the next key; two quick taps — locked.
• Win+Space — another language.
• Your own shortcuts — «Shortcuts».
• Translation, voice and suggestions work; autocorrect and punctuation are off here on purpose.
• Cursor keys on the mobile keyboard — Look → Keys.

• Models — «Voice and translation» → «Offline models»: «Download», then «Open» in the browser and choose OffKey (or «Install downloaded files»).
• 🎤 — dictate; «comma», «period», «question mark», «new line» put marks; ✕ — cancel.
• ⇄ — translation; another tap — the other direction.
• Type in your language — the translation goes into the field after a sentence, a pause or Enter.
• ↶ — bring back the original.
• Clipboard — translate the selection or paste a translation of the copied text.
• Your own terms — «Translation glossary».

• «Bluetooth keyboard» → turn it on.
• The first time — «Make the phone visible», and on the computer Settings → Bluetooth → Add device.
• The Bluetooth button on the keyboard — keys go to the computer; another tap — back to the phone.
• The computer's language — the same as the phone's; Win+Space switches both.
• While keys go to the computer — suggestions, translation and voice pause.

• Hold the comma and let go — the emoji panel; arrows turn pages, the first page — the most used.\n• Your own emoji and smileys — «Emoji and stickers» → «My emoji»; they get a ★ page.\n• OffKey stickers and your own animated ones — there too; they go into apps that accept them.

• «My dictionary» — add and remove your own words for suggestions.
• Remembering typed words — turned on there; words stay on the phone.
• Import — .txt (a word per line, into the language selected at the top) or JSON {"uk": [...], "pl": [...]}.
• Export — all your words as JSON.
• Full backup — «About» → «Backup»: settings, emoji, shortcuts, dictionary, glossary. Models are not included.
